biography.value: Death knights are lethal warriors and overbearing commanders with dark pasts. Some seek to break the curses that bind them to undeath, though their selfish souls keep them chained to their fate forever. Others, like the infamous Lord Soth, brood in gloomy ruins for centuries and stir only when something rekindles their undying evil.

description.value: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Undead creatures of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice (excluding itself) in a 60-foot Emanation originating from it have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. It can't use this trait if it has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition.

If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed before it atones for its evil, it gains a new body in [[/r 1d10]] days, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in a location significant to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=jY3gm1VFc8Zzp0i3]], each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within 120 feet. Failure: [[/damage 10d6 average type=fire]] damage plus [[/damage 10d6 average type=necrotic]] damage. Success: Half damage.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommand000]{Command}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPhantomSte]{Phantom Steed}

2/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.spells.Item.9l9wvGNjcFI9kCHq]{Destructive Wave} (Necrotic), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic}

activation.condition: The death knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon

description.value: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} adds 6 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses Spellcasting to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommand000]{Command}. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=EBh535uwZu6UsJbF]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within 120 feet. Failure: [[/damage 5d6 average type=necrotic]] damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Dread Blade attack.
